 INSERT INTO QA_ACCT (account, seq_acct_id, reg_type, traunch_id, principal, exchanges) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value, Count(DISTINCT e.exchange_date) exchanges FROM tu_acct_buckets p, tu_acct a left JOIN tu_exchange_date e ON a.seq_acct_id = e.seq_acct_id AND e.reverse_date IS NULL AND extract(YEAR from e.exchange_date) = extract(YEAR from sysdate) WHERE a.traunch_id = 100080 AND a.acct_state = '91' AND a.seq_acct_id = p.seq_acct_id AND a.reg_type IN ('R', 'U', 'T') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_constraint c WHERE c.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND (c.ctl_rec_stat IS NULL OR c.ctl_rec_stat = 'A')) AND p.bucket_id = '1' AND NOT exists (SELECT 1 FROM tu_fin_txn f WHERE f.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND f.ctl_rec_stat NOT IN ('P', 'O', 'B', 'R', 'D','J','X','N', 'C') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenv_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tjet_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_bnk_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_alloc ac WHERE ac.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id and ac.fund_id in (1050005, 1037005, 1051005, 1043007, 1048007, 1042007, 1039007, 1047007, 1045007, 1040007, 1059007, 1053007, 1060007, 1054007, 1064007, 1055007, 1052007, 1075007, 1041007, 1076007, 1038007, 1046007) ) GROUP BY a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.Value ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200

 INSERT INTO QA_ACCT (account, seq_acct_id, reg_type, traunch_id, principal, exchanges) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value, Count(DISTINCT e.exchange_date) exchanges FROM tu_acct_buckets p, tu_acct a left JOIN tu_exchange_date e ON a.seq_acct_id = e.seq_acct_id AND e.reverse_date IS NULL AND extract(YEAR from e.exchange_date) = extract(YEAR from sysdate) WHERE a.traunch_id = 100084 AND a.acct_state = '91' AND a.seq_acct_id = p.seq_acct_id AND a.reg_type IN ('R', 'U', 'T') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_constraint c WHERE c.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND (c.ctl_rec_stat IS NULL OR c.ctl_rec_stat = 'A')) AND p.bucket_id = '1' AND NOT exists (SELECT 1 FROM tu_fin_txn f WHERE f.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND f.ctl_rec_stat NOT IN ('P', 'O', 'B', 'R', 'D','J','X','N', 'C') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenv_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tjet_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_bnk_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_alloc ac WHERE ac.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id and ac.fund_id in (1050005, 1037005, 1051005, 1043007, 1048007, 1042007, 1039007, 1047007, 1045007, 1040007, 1059007, 1053007, 1060007, 1054007, 1064007, 1055007, 1052007, 1075007, 1041007, 1076007, 1038007, 1046007) ) GROUP BY a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.Value ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200

 INSERT INTO QA_ACCT (account, seq_acct_id, reg_type, traunch_id, principal, exchanges) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value, Count(DISTINCT e.exchange_date) exchanges FROM tu_acct_buckets p, tu_acct a left JOIN tu_exchange_date e ON a.seq_acct_id = e.seq_acct_id AND e.reverse_date IS NULL AND extract(YEAR from e.exchange_date) = extract(YEAR from sysdate) WHERE a.traunch_id = 100080 AND a.acct_state = '91' AND a.seq_acct_id = p.seq_acct_id AND a.reg_type IN ('R', 'U', 'T') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_constraint c WHERE c.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND (c.ctl_rec_stat IS NULL OR c.ctl_rec_stat = 'A')) AND p.bucket_id = '1' AND NOT exists (SELECT 1 FROM tu_fin_txn f WHERE f.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id AND f.ctl_rec_stat NOT IN ('P', 'O', 'B', 'R', 'D','J','X','N', 'C') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenv_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tjet_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_bnk_acct_txn t WHERE t.seq_fin_txn_id = f.seq_fin_txn_id) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tu_acct_alloc ac WHERE ac.seq_acct_id = a.seq_acct_id and ac.fund_id in (1050005, 1037005, 1051005, 1043007, 1048007, 1042007, 1039007, 1047007, 1045007, 1040007, 1059007, 1053007, 1060007, 1054007, 1064007, 1055007, 1052007, 1075007, 1041007, 1076007, 1038007, 1046007) ) GROUP BY a.uii_acct_id||a.uii_acct_ext, a.seq_acct_id, a.reg_type, a.traunch_id, p.bucket_value ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.Value ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
